members.name: title
members.doc: The content of the trigger button, which names the section.

members.name: expanded
members.doc: Whether the Disclosure is open, when the caller controls it. Inside a DisclosureGroup the group owns expansion and this is ignored.

members.name: defaultExpanded
members.doc: Whether the Disclosure starts open, when it controls itself.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the Disclosure: it can be neither opened nor closed.

members.name: id
members.doc: Identifies the Disclosure. A DisclosureGroup's expanded ids refer to it.

members.name: onExpandedChange
members.doc: Reports the Disclosure opening or closing.
